title: Submit scan request v1
description: An origin observation submitted for durable plant acceptance; the gateway supplies its acceptance time.

eventId.description: A globally unique event identifier generated at the origin and retained across retries.

correlationId.description: Connects this observation to logs and events in the same operation.

tenantId.description: The platform tenant that owns the plant.

plantId.description: The plant where the observation occurred.

stationId.description: The logical operator station or fixed-reader zone.

deviceId.description: The scanner, reader, or simulator that produced the observation.

identifier.description: The external identifier observed by the device. It need not resolve to a known item.

technology.description: The technology used to read the identifier.

value.description: The identifier exactly as normalized by the producing adapter.
